# Indonesia Bisa

> A small, free directory of Indonesia-focused tools and data, built on public and community APIs (BMKG, Indodax, Emsifa, KodePos, libur.deno.dev, EQuran.id). Part of UwU Apps.

Indonesia Bisa is an independent project and is not affiliated with any government agency or data provider it links to. Each page proxies a single public API through a small serverless function that adds validation, caching and rate limiting, then renders the result.

## Pages

- [Home](https://indonesia.uwuapps.org/): Searchable directory of every page on this site.
- [Weather Forecast](https://indonesia.uwuapps.org/weather): Village-level Indonesia weather forecasts from BMKG's public API, looked up by adm4 area code.
- [Earthquake & Tsunami Watch](https://indonesia.uwuapps.org/quake): Latest felt earthquake plus recent M5.0+ quakes and tsunami potential, from BMKG's real-time TEWS feed.
- [Crypto Ticker (IDR)](https://indonesia.uwuapps.org/crypto): Live rupiah-denominated crypto prices from Indodax's public ticker API.
- [Wilayah Indonesia](https://indonesia.uwuapps.org/emsifa): Cascading province, regency, district and village picker with official area codes, from the Emsifa community API.
- [Postal Code Lookup](https://indonesia.uwuapps.org/kodepos): Search Indonesian postal codes by code or place name, with coordinates and timezone.
- [Public Holidays](https://indonesia.uwuapps.org/holidays): Indonesia's national holidays and cuti bersama for any year.
- [Quran](https://indonesia.uwuapps.org/quran): All 114 surah with Indonesian translation, transliteration and recitation audio, from EQuran.id.

## Notes

- All data-bearing pages handle upstream downtime, empty responses, schema drift and rate limits, and fall back to the last cached response when the source API is unreachable.
- This site is a Progressive Web App; once visited, its pages and previously-fetched API data continue to work offline.
